name: Gopal Chips Cream and Onion
ingredients_raw: POTATO (60%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALMOLEIN OIL), SUGAR, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, MALTODEXTRIN, MILK SOLIDS, CHEESE POWDER (0.1%), ONION POWDER (1.3%), FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 627, INS 631), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551), NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHEESE & ONION FLAVOURS AND STABILIZER (INS 414). ALLERGEN ADVICE: CONTAINS MILK MAY CONTAINS CEREALS CONTAINING GLUTEN, MILK, TREE NUTS, PEANUTS SESAME SEEDS, MUSTARD SEEDS AND SOYA
